sources.title: StemSplitio/htdemucs-ft-vocals-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repo packages sub-model 3 of the htdemucs_ft 4-bag ensemble as a single 316 MB .onnx file plus a ~150-line numpy reference inference script. Verified to be numerically equivalent to the original PyTorch model.

sources.snippet: Run and export HT-Demucs / Demucs music source separation as ONNX. Pure numpy + onnxruntime inference (no PyTorch). The canonical reference for the four torch.onnx.export blockers on htdemucs.
